name: devops-remote-senior
jobText:
Senior DevOps Engineer — Remote (India)

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing platform team. This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates anywhere in India.

Responsibilities:
- Design and operate our AWS infrastructure across multiple environments
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions
- Manage Kubernetes clusters running our microservices
- Write and maintain Terraform modules for infrastructure as code
- Partner with engineering teams to improve deployment reliability

Requirements:
- 8+ years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability roles
- Strong hands-on experience with AWS
- Production experience with Kubernetes
- Experience writing Terraform for infrastructure as code
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Nice to have:
- Experience with Python scripting
- Familiarity with Datadog or similar observability tools

This role owns the platform end to end — you will drive infrastructure decisions, not just execute a backlog handed to you by another team.
